about.heading: A sanctuary of compassion, built in her memory
about.sub: Dr. Smita Sharma — educator, mentor, and a soul of grace — spent nearly two decades shaping minds at LBSIM, New Delhi. This foundation carries her belief forward: if we have the ability to help, we also have the responsibility to act.

causes.heading: The causes she lived for, the work we continue

donation.heading: Your generosity helps bring care, dignity, and hope to lives that need it most.
donation.sub: Every contribution becomes a hand held, a meal served, a life dignified.

volunteer.heading: Be the change — carry her light forward
volunteer.sub: Join our circle of compassion. Your time, skills, and willingness to help carry forward the values Dr. Smita Sharma lived by.

testimonials.heading: Real stories from the lives she touched

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about giving, volunteering, and walking with us.

items.a: Every contribution goes directly to cancer patient support, children's education, elder care, and our gaushala — food, medicines, and dignity for those who need it most.
Yes. Donations are processed securely, and every rupee is accounted for with the same integrity Dr. Sharma lived by.

items.q: Can I make a monthly donation?
items.a: Yes — a monthly gift becomes a steady companion for the families we walk beside, sustaining care all year round.

items.q: Can I volunteer without previous experience?
items.a: Yes. What matters most is presence and compassion — our team will guide you every step of the way.

items.q: Will I receive updates about my donation?
items.a: Yes — heartfelt stories and honest reports of the lives your kindness touched will reach you regularly.

items.q: How can my organization partner with you?
items.a: Write to us at contact@drsmitasharmafoundation.org — we welcome partnerships in healthcare, education, elder care, and animal welfare.

cta.heading: Every act of kindness continues her journey
